market_question: Will Venezuela recognize Israel by June 30?
reasoning: Venezuela severed diplomatic ties with Israel in 2009 and has since maintained a fiercely anti-Israel stance aligned with Iran, Syria, and Hezbollah. There are no diplomatic signals or incentives suggesting a reversal of this policy, especially within a short 7-month window. The probability of formal recognition of Israel is negligible, far below the market's implied 1.7%.
evidence_points: Venezuela broke relations with Israel in 2009 under Hugo Chávez and has remained hostile under Maduro.
The government is ideologically committed to the Palestinian cause and part of the anti-Israel axis.
No known normalization talks or diplomatic gestures have occurred between Venezuela and Israel.
sources_consulted: Recent geopolitical analysis on Venezuela-Iran-Israel dynamics
